description:
Team Description:

​We are a dynamic, inter-agency team from Labuan, Malaysia, bringing together frontline professionals from Hospital Labuan and the Civil Defence Force Labuan. Our core expertise lies at the critical intersection of healthcare, psychological first aid (MHPSS), and emergency disaster response. We are passionate about leveraging our real-world crisis management and clinical experience to solve global challenges, especially for mental health.
summary:
We are developing a software to help with health monitoring specifically for astronaut in space. We are using pictoblox.ai as our way to develop and code it into a working program. 

Through face detection, voice recognition, text to speech extension and human body detection. We address the problems of how to detect health condition of astronaut by measuring space radiation exposure day-to-day, measuring calcium to check on altered gravity affecting the bone density, measuring heart rate and other vital signs. Each of the problems will be calculated and if it exceeds the threshold, the astronaut will be notified and be directed to medical professional for further assessment.

We also assess for mental health of the astronaut and provide a simple mental exercise to release stress through progressive muscle relaxation and deep breathing exercise to calm the astronauts. 

These are important because physical and mental health are always interconnected. For astronaut who stays a long time in space are more prone to mental health when they undergone constant stress and isolation. Thus, we hope with these project, it can help astronauts and long term space projects to be successful.
details:
What does our project do?


We are doing a program to monitor the surrounding, mental health and physical
condition of the astronaut.

How does it work?


The project using face detection, voice recognition, text to speech extension and
human body detection as well as surrounding to assess the condition of the
astronaut. A comprehensive question will be asked and It takes around 10- 15
minutes to fully complete it. The program will ask questions regarding vital signs,
radiation exposure through dosimeters, urine calcium to estimate the risk of bone loss
density. Each of the components will be detected by the program and will provide the
risk the astronaut is having and calculate it to see the overall health condition of the
astronaut before giving follow through management to the astronaut.
On the other hand, if the program detected the astronaut is having stress or having
poor mental health. A simple mental health check will be initiated. Once the mental
health condition is at risk. The program will initiate progressive muscle relaxation and
deep breathing exercise. These exercises aim to calm and reduce the stress of the
astronaut.

What benefits do our projects have?


The benefits of our project are physical and mental health can be quickly monitored
and can be incorporated into the routine of the astronaut day to day.

What is the intended impact of our project?


The intended impact of our project is to increase the productivity of astronauts in space.
As any poor physical or mental health condition will reduce the productivity and
increase chances of mission failures.
On the other hand, with this project. Mental health condition and prevention can be
done quickly and a direct intervention can limit the progression of mental health deterioration.

What tools, coding language, hardware, or software did we use to develop our project?

Tools- Pictoblox.ai
Coding Language- scratch 3.0
Hardware- Computer
Software- Pictoblox.ai

How is my project creative?


Our project incorporate the knowledge of our team members ( medical doctor in psychiatry and counsellor in Angkatan Pertahanan Awam) We make this project using face detection, voice recognition, text to speech extension and
human body detection as well as surrounding which is a revolutionising experience especially in the field of mental health and physical health. With the facial expression of stress, the AI can directly detect any signs of stress and provide a quick assessment as well as provide quick help to the person in need. With the technology that NASA had, more and more information could be picked up and extend this project into space exploration and long term health assessment of astronauts. If more experts collaborate together, this project can expand to have a wider array of functions in the future.

Factor my team consider?


There are several factors that our team focused on. Physical health monitoring is quite challenging so we try to get as much data as we can to develop a simple project and program for the astronaut with the minimum time possible as the astronaut has a tight schedule to follow.
Mental health aspect is the key factor our team considers, because we specialise in treating psychiatric patients. Isolation brings a lot of mental health conditions after prolonged exposure to it. So to get an overview of the mental state of the condition is of paramount importance considering each space expedition has a very big mission and low room of error. To make sure the astronaut is in very good condition is our priority.
